zh: 如果反转区间的首尾字符相同，把两端同时向内收缩一格结果不变；所以每个“与原串不同”的结果都能对应到一个首尾字符不同的区间。
首尾不同的区间两两得到的结果各不相同（端点就是结果与原串最早、最晚不同的位置），因此答案 = 首尾字符不同的区间个数 + 1（原串本身）。
从左到右扫描并记录每个字母已出现的次数；扫到下标 i 的字符 c 时，它与前面 i 个字符中不等于 c 的那些都能组成首尾不同的区间，把 i-count[c] 加进答案，再让 count[c] 加一；答案初值为 1。结果可能超过 32 位，用 64 位整数。
en: If a reversed range starts and ends with the same character, shrinking both ends inward by one gives the same result; so every result that differs from the original corresponds to a range whose two end characters differ.

Ranges with different end characters all produce different results (their endpoints are the first and last positions where the result differs from the original), so the answer is the number of such ranges plus 1 for the original string.

Scan from left to right keeping how many times each letter has appeared; at index i with character c, every earlier character not equal to c forms such a range with it, so add i - count[c] to the answer and then increment count[c]; start the answer at 1. The result can exceed 32 bits, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

From the total number of endpoint pairs, remove the pairs whose two ends are equal, then add the original string; while scanning, each character contributes the number of earlier characters different from it.

## Correctness

For any reversed range, equal first and last characters can be removed inward at the same time without changing the result. So every result other than the original string corresponds uniquely to a range whose two ends differ, and its endpoints are exactly the first and last positions where the result differs from the original; ranges with different endpoints cannot produce the same result. Counting the original string as well gives all possible results.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(26).
